purpose: Test the smallest second nonmetricity invariant that gives the two physical metric potentials different baryon-predicted responses while leaving the transverse-traceless wave cone unchanged at linear order.
physical_postulates: Baryonic stress-energy is the only material source.
Matter and light couple minimally to one physical metric g_ab.
The independent connection is flat and torsion-free and has no freely initialized halo profile.
Sigma is a nonlinear self-interaction of the second nonmetricity trace, not an invisible material component.
The same action, acceleration scale, boundary condition, and physical metric apply to every object.
No object label, per-object gravity constant, or lensing-only multiplier is permitted.
decision_rule: Advance only if the weak equations are distinct from a known nonrelativistic comparator and pass both galaxy and raw cluster gates. If they reduce exactly to QUMOND dynamics with a half-Newtonian, half-QUMOND Weyl potential, run that fixed Weyl map and retire on a raw topology failure without fitting parameters.
claim_boundary: QUMOND and general quadratic nonmetricity gravity are prior art.
This cycle tests a specific one-metric geometric completion and does not claim QUMOND as a Sigma invention.
Failure rejects this single trace-invariant action, not every multi-invariant nonmetricity theory.
